results.title: AIO.GEO Protocol: Audit AI search structure. Dry run fixes. Receipts. | Product Hunt
results.content:
To answer your question: the "fix" covers both, but we separate them cleanly into two axes:

1. Cognitive (Readability & Content Clarity): Auditing how directly your content answers implied questions, structural schema, and RAG-readability so LLMs can parse and cite you without hallucinating.
2. Kinetic (Actionability & Code): Going beyond text to generate actual execution assets (llms.txt, api-catalog, MCP cards, auth.md) so AI agents can actually do business on your site (call APIs, auth, perform tasks), not just read it.

You get an exact diagnosis of what's blocking AI, the dry-run files to fix it on the spot, and a rescore to verify the improvement. Receipts over guesswork!
